content: sops-nix: flake input github:Mic92/sops-nix; modules sops-nix.nixosModules.sops and sops-nix.homeManagerModules.sops. Options: defaultSopsFile, defaultSopsFormat, age.keyFile, age.generateKey, age.sshKeyPaths, secrets.<name>, validateSopsFiles. HM standalone: import homeManagerModules.sops in home modules, keyFile pointing at ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt string (absolute path string, NOT a Nix path literal — that would copy the private key into the store), generateKey = true creates host key. NixOS: keyFile /etc/sops/age/keys.txt or sshKeyPaths [/etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key]. Per-host age keys with .sops.yaml creation_rules; sops updatekeys after adding hosts. Works with NixOS module via home-manager.sharedModules = [ inputs.sops-nix.homeManagerModules.sops ].
